# Radio

Radio buttons choose one of a few mutually exclusive options when all of them should stay visible (use Select
when there are many). Usually used through `Radio.Group`.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Mutually exclusive options such as access level, storage type or visibility

## Import

```ts
import { Radio } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

For a few mutually exclusive options that are all shown.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Radio.Group
      defaultValue="read"
      options={[
        { value: 'read', label: 'Read only' },
        { value: 'write', label: 'Read and write' },
        { value: 'none', label: 'No access' },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Button style

`Radio.Button` forms a group of buttons; for switching between two or three views, prefer Segmented.

```tsx
export function Buttons() {
  return (
    <Radio.Group defaultValue="team">
      <Radio.Button value="team">Team</Radio.Button>
      <Radio.Button value="public">Public</Radio.Button>
      <Radio.Button value="private">Only me</Radio.Button>
    </Radio.Group>
  )
}
```

## Props

No props of its own.

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`RadioProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
